# MYCOMIC fixtures

`series.html` retains the public [葬送者芙莉莲](https://mycomic.com/cn/comics/35937) metadata and 151 catalog entries across three groups, captured on 2026-10-25. It includes the work's author credits, genres, year, and rating. Each group preserves its Alpine `x-data` value and subheading.

`reader.html` retains the 39 numbered images and selectors for chapter `492177`, including eager and lazy sources and the first-page scanlation notice. Browser save tests use the complete catalog and page list with controlled PNG responses.
